map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Henry and Morrow publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-11-02 04:00): early in person 43,072 (state 41,446). Clermont (as of 2026-11-01 23:39): mail returned 12,218 (state 12,213); early in person 19,198 (state 18,421). Crawford (as of 2026-10-31 15:48): mail returned 1,929 (state 1,879); early in person 3,570 (state 3,406). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-11-01 18:38): early in person 54,042 (state 51,601). Franklin (as of 2026-11-02 00:12): mail returned 70,372 (state 69,136); early in person 93,166 (state 89,279); ballots sent 82,845 (state 82,838). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-31 20:09): early in person 74,521 (state 74,517). Henry (as of 2026-10-27 16:58): early in person 3,552 (state 3,380). Morrow (as of 2026-11-01 17:21): mail returned 1,316 (state 1,302); early in person 3,669 (state 3,473).
